# VayuGuard — Make-in-India Air Purification

> VayuGuard Climate Tech Pvt Ltd is a New Delhi–based climate-tech company (founded 2019) that builds air purification for central HVAC systems and individual rooms. Its patented HCAC (Hybrid Central Air Cleaner) treats air inside AHUs and ducts with washable electro-charged media; VayuShield retrofits existing split and cassette ACs into purifiers; UVGI systems disinfect air with UV-C; ANOP (Plasm-ION) bipolar ionization neutralizes odours and VOCs in ducts; and VayuView monitors deliver live PM2.5, PM10, CO₂ and TVOC dashboards. VayuGuard serves homes, offices, hospitals, schools, hotels and industry across Delhi NCR and India, with free site assessments and quotes within 48 hours.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the VayuGuard HCAC and how does it work?** The HCAC (Hybrid Central Air Cleaner) is a patented, made-in-India purification stage installed inside AHUs and HVAC ducts. Air passes through washable electro-charged media that captures sub-micron particles like PM2.5 with very low pressure drop, so the entire building breathes filtered air from one central system.

**Does VayuShield work with existing split or cassette ACs?** Yes. VayuShield is a retractable module for standard split and cassette AC indoor units; it installs tool-less in minutes and adds HEPA-grade filtration to the AC airflow.

**How does UVGI kill airborne pathogens?** UV-C light at germicidal wavelengths breaks the DNA/RNA of viruses, bacteria and fungi so they cannot replicate. Upper-room units disinfect occupied spaces continuously; in-duct versions treat air moving through HVAC systems.

**Do VayuGuard systems need filter replacement?** The core HCAC media is washable and reusable — rinse on schedule instead of buying filters. Room units use a washable pre-filter plus long-life stages; VayuView alerts when any stage needs attention.

**How much does a system cost?** Pricing depends on the space and configuration. VayuGuard provides free site assessments across Delhi NCR and quotes within 48 hours.
